comparisons.reason: Feature 0 requires an explicit contrast of the OP's view with a relatable lived experience (the comment must say it differs from or conflicts with the OP's view). Feature 1 only requires a concrete personal anecdote that illustrates real-world consequences of the OP's claim, with no explicit contrast and no relatability requirement. Null handling also differs: feature 0 gives null for an empty list or missing title/argument, while feature 1 gives 0 for an empty list. Outputs differ on eligible rows.
